messages:
deploy-bot: deploy complete: inference-proxy v2.14.0 -> prod-west at 2026-03-21T15:02:14Z. Canary 5% -> ok. Post-deploy synths: 96% green, but us-west/embed-synth (probe id: synth-embed-13) 502s and p95 latency spike to 1.8s. Rolling to remaining regions paused.
Alicia: seeing same in telemetry, p95 up across prefills, small spike in 502s isolated to edge pool e-7.
Sam: oncall are you looking? I'm on it, pulled traces, 502s map to nginx 502 from upstream: upstream-broker timed out.
Jordan: I noticed the new lib 'fastsync' added in v2.14 that touches blocking IO in hot path. Could be threadpool saturation.
Renee: QA reran smoke harness with 200 concurrent synths and couldn't reproduce locally.
Sam: i've attached trace snippet: 
```
upstream-broker error: timed out waiting for write
threadpool threads busy=100/100
```
Alicia: Given impact is limited but likely regression, propose pause rollouts and pin routing for prod-west to v2.13.9 for 30m. Then either hotfix or rollback full service.
Jordan: Agree. Pinning routing now via mux: 
`redwoodctl route pin inference-proxy --version v2.13.9 --region prod-west --ttl 1800`
deploy-bot: routing pin initiated by alicia at 5478901242 — success
Devops-bot: note: pinned routes affect 12% of traffic; autoscaler unaffected.
Sam: I'll try to reproduce with small load on e-7 edge pool and enable verbose logging.
Renee: If we rollback, let's capture canary logs to compare. Also adding synthetic test that stresses the blocking IO for coverage.
Alicia: Decision: hold rollout globally, pin routing for prod-west, immediate revert of fastsync in a hotfix branch. Jordan + Sam to coordinate hotfix. Renee to add target probe.
Jordan: Branch created hotfix/revert-fastsync. Deploying candidate to prod-west canary now (5%).
deploy-bot: hotfix-deploy started: inference-proxy@hotfix/revert-fastsync -> prod-west canary
Sam: observing canary now, initial probes look healthy, p95 down to 0.32s, no 502s in last 5m :thumbsup: 
Alicia: if canary stays green for 15m we will unpin and continue rollout. Logging an action item for postmortem and release note update (missing mention of fastsync in breaking changes).
Renee: I'll update release notes and add synth test. Will also run regression evals after unpin.
Alicia: thanks. I'll update the release window board and close the hold once unpin done.
Jordan: FYI — scheduled a full rollback window if canary degrades: 30m from now.
Sam: thanks team. keeping eyes on dashboards.
deploy-bot: thread closed for now; reopen on regressions.
